title: Polly Parrot
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig, this is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇，这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa and her family are visiting Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig.
lines.zh: 佩奇一家人来看望猪奶奶和猪爷爷。

lines.en: Granny Pig! Grandpa Pig! Granky Pig! Papa Egg!
lines.zh: 猪奶奶！猪爷爷！猪格兰奇！蛋爸爸！

lines.en: Hello my little ones, come inside, we have a surprise.
lines.zh: 你好，我的孩子们，进来吧，我们有惊喜。

lines.en: We have a new pet, can you guess what it is?
lines.zh: 我们有一只新宠物，你能猜出它是什么吗？

lines.en: No, it's not a dinosaur! Come and see.
lines.zh: 不，这不是恐龙！快来看看吧。

lines.en: Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig have a pet parrot.
lines.zh: 猪奶奶和猪爷爷有一只宠物鹦鹉。

lines.en: Peppa, George, this is our pet parrot. She's called Polly.
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，这是我们的宠物鹦鹉。她叫波莉。

lines.en: Mummy, why does Polly copy everything that Granny says?
lines.zh: 妈妈，为什么波莉要抄袭奶奶说的一切？

lines.en: That's what parrots do. I'll show you.
lines.zh: 这就是鹦鹉所做的。我会告诉你。

lines.en: Peppa, George, come on, there's chocolate cake!
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，来吧，巧克力蛋糕来了！

lines.en: Peppa and George love eating chocolate cake, but today
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢吃巧克力蛋糕，但今天

lines.en: they are in a hurry to get back and play with Polly Parrot.
lines.zh: 他们急着回去和鹦鹉波利一起玩。

lines.en: What noisy little ones you are!
lines.zh: 你们真是吵闹的小家伙！

lines.en: Granny, please can we leave the table and go and see Polly Parrot?
lines.zh: 奶奶，我们可以离开餐桌去看鹦鹉波莉吗？

lines.en: Are you sure you've completely finished your cake?
lines.zh: 你确定你的蛋糕已经吃完了吗？

lines.en: George is a little bit shy.
Peppa and George are really enjoying playing with Polly Parrot.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治非常喜欢和波利鹦鹉一起玩耍。

lines.en: Peppa and George are pretending to be parrots.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治正在假装是鹦鹉。

lines.en: Peppa is thinking of something else to say to Polly Parrot.
lines.zh: 佩奇正在想别的事情要对鹦鹉波莉说。

lines.en: Peppa, George, have you been playing with Polly?
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，你和波莉一起玩了吗？

lines.en: Polly is such a sweet parrot.
lines.zh: 波莉真是一只可爱的鹦鹉。
